_description: Native Top N filter combined with another dimension filter. The other filter must be a context filter, or the Top N is computed before it and the view shows fewer than N items.

topn_filter._placement: Inside worksheet > table > view, alongside other <filter> elements and before <sort>/<computed-sort> and <slices>.

context_filter._description: The other dimension filter, marked context='true' so it runs before the Top N.

notes.why_context: Tableau computes a Top N filter before ordinary dimension filters (order: context filters, then Top N, then dimension filters, then measure filters). So the Top N is ranked over all the data, and the other filter then removes some of those N. Example: top 10 artists of all time, then a 'last decade' date filter, leaves only the 4 who charted in that decade. context='true' on the other filter makes Tableau apply it first and rank the Top N within what's left.
notes.which_filters: Mark every dimension filter that should narrow the Top N's population (dates, segments, regions) as context='true'. Measure filters and table-calc filters always run after the Top N, so making them context filters isn't possible or needed.
notes.date_filters: This applies to date filters too, e.g. a categorical filter on [yr:Date:ok] or a relative-date filter: add context='true' to the date filter, not to the Top N.
notes.top_n_does_not_sort: A Top N filter picks which members to keep but doesn't order them. Add a <computed-sort> on the same dimension using the same measure (see sort.json) to rank the bars.
notes.expression: The order groupfilter's expression is a calculation in the datasource's own field names, e.g. SUM([Profit]), not a column-instance name.
notes.count_and_end: count is N. end='top' keeps the highest N, end='bottom' the lowest.
notes.member_quoting: String members are written with escaped double quotes: member='"Consumer"' in the XML.
notes.alternative: For Top N within each partition (e.g. top 10 per month), use the INDEX() table-calc pattern in topn-table-calc-filter.json instead. Table-calc filters run after all dimension filters, so they need no context filter.
notes.verification: This structure validates against the bundled 2026.2 XSD and matches filters Tableau itself writes. The member count is only visible in a render or in query results.
